instructions.title: Open the Phase One Expedition Archive
instructions.message: Open the existing Mission Control Main Operations Console.
instructions.guidance: Review the persisted SOL 1–9 expedition records and preserve each original report and its evidence references.
instructions.activity: Open the archive through the existing Mission Control interaction.

instructions.title: Review Individual SOL Reports
instructions.message: Review the available daily reports individually in Mission Control.
instructions.guidance: Use only persisted reports and records. Keep each report associated with its source SOL; do not infer missing reports.
instructions.activity: Review the available SOL reports without changing their source records.

instructions.title: Verify Habitat Main Monitor Status
instructions.message: Travel to Habitat — Main Status Console and press E at the existing Habitat Main Monitor interaction point.
instructions.guidance: This is a physical trigger check. Review the related persisted mission record and record verified, flagged, or incomplete. Do not infer status from an unrelated display.
instructions.activity: Record the current status for HAB_MONITOR_01.

instructions.title: Verify Existing Outpost Section Records
instructions.message: Inspect applicable records at their existing physical displays.
instructions.guidance: Only verify records that actually exist and are relevant to the handover. Mark absent mappings unresolved; reaching a display does not verify a record.
instructions.activity: Review the original record before recording a separate verification result.

instructions.title: Verify Scientific Targets and Observations
instructions.message: Review the selected target and its related observation records in the Science Lab.
instructions.guidance: Preserve the target identifier and cite the source SOL and task for each record. Do not add unsupported conclusions.
instructions.activity: Compare only records with an explicit target relationship.

instructions.title: Verify Soil Sample Provenance and Cultivation Records
instructions.message: Review the existing target, soil sample and cultivation history in the Science Lab.
instructions.guidance: Keep the target selection, collected sample and cultivation experiment as separate linked records. Report unavailable relationships honestly.
instructions.activity: Confirm provenance from persisted identifiers and evidence only.

instructions.title: Verify Environmental, Emission-Control and Equipment Records
instructions.message: Review available operational records at the existing Habitat and Engineering displays.
instructions.guidance: Use recorded values and statuses only. Do not treat missing values as zero or as a fault without supporting evidence.
instructions.activity: Record the source display and preserve unknown or unsupported fields.

instructions.title: Perform Cross-SOL Record Comparison
instructions.message: Return to Mission Control to compare records with explicit shared identifiers or provenance links.
instructions.guidance: Show source SOL, task and evidence for each comparison. Do not compare records based only on similar labels.
instructions.activity: Review related records without changing their original values.

instructions.title: Review Verification Results and Outstanding Issues
instructions.message: Review verification states and outstanding items in Mission Control.
instructions.guidance: Keep flagged and incomplete items visible. Do not mark unknown or unreviewed information verified.
instructions.activity: Confirm the summary reflects the actual persisted verification records.

instructions.title: Generate the Phase One Final Expedition Report
instructions.message: Generate a report preview from authoritative persisted expedition records.
instructions.guidance: Include source references, verification states, unresolved issues and limitations. Do not fabricate measurements or findings.
instructions.activity: Review the generated preview and its source references.

instructions.title: Prepare the Incoming Crew Handover
instructions.message: Prepare the incoming crew handover from verified records and documented limitations.
instructions.guidance: Separate confirmed findings from interpretations, recommendations and unresolved questions.
instructions.activity: Add evidence-based continuation priorities to the report.

instructions.title: Submit the Phase One Final Expedition Report
instructions.message: Review and submit the final report through the existing Mission Control workflow.
instructions.guidance: Keep flagged or incomplete items visible and report whether verification is complete or still has outstanding issues.
instructions.activity: Submit only after reviewing report completeness and outstanding issues.

completion.title: Sol 10 Expedition Handover Complete
completion.message: The Phase One report and its documented verification status have been submitted.
